items.title: Live: Ukraine, Russia and US to resume peace talks in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States are meeting in Abu Dhabi for their first trilateral talks in more than nine months, as Washington pushes for an end to the war and Kyiv faces pressure to make territorial concessions. European representatives will also attend, amid fears that US President Donald Trump could press Ukraine to accept a deal on Moscow's terms. Follow our live blog for the latest events.

ai.sum: Ukrainian, Russian and US negotiators are meeting in Abu Dhabi for their first trilateral talks in over nine months, with European representatives attending.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukrainian negotiating group arrives in UAE for trilateral meeting
items.summary: A Ukrainian delegation has arrived in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), where on Tuesday in Abu Dhabi it will hold the first meeting in a trilateral format involving Ukraine, the United States and the Russian Federation, as well as separate talks with European partners to propose de-escalation steps and prepare a leaders-level summit, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in his evening video address on Monday.

ai.sum: A Ukrainian delegation arrived in Abu Dhabi for the first trilateral meeting with the United States and Russia, plus separate talks with Europeans.
